name: azure-document-intelligence
description: Analyze invoices, receipts, and document layout with Azure AI Document Intelligence prebuilt models

envVars.name: AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY
envVars.description: Key for your Azure Document Intelligence resource (Keys and Endpoint blade in the Azure portal), sent as the Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key header

envVars.name: AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT
envVars.description: Hostname of your resource endpoint, e.g. myresource.cognitiveservices.azure.com. All tools send their requests to this host.

locale.description: Locale hint for text recognition, e.g. 'en-US'

base64Source.description: Base64-encoded contents of the document to analyze. Provide either urlSource or base64Source

prompts.title: Extract invoice fields
prompts.prompt: Analyze this invoice with Azure Document Intelligence and summarize the vendor, invoice ID, due date, line items, and total.

prompts.title: Scan a receipt
prompts.prompt: Analyze this receipt with Azure Document Intelligence and report the merchant, date, and total amount.

prompts.title: Document to Markdown
prompts.prompt: Run layout analysis on this document with outputContentFormat=markdown and return the document content as Markdown.

SETUP_GUIDE.title: Azure Document Intelligence setup

steps.title: Create a Document Intelligence resource
steps.description: In the Azure portal, create an Azure AI Document Intelligence (formerly Form Recognizer) resource: https://portal.azure.com/#create/Microsoft.CognitiveServicesFormRecognizer. Choose the free F0 pricing tier to test at no cost (500 pages/month; F0 only processes the first 2 pages of each request).

steps.title: Copy the key and endpoint
steps.description: Open the resource's 'Keys and Endpoint' blade. Store KEY 1 as AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY and the endpoint hostname (e.g. myresource.cognitiveservices.azure.com, without https://) as AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT.

steps.title: Run an analysis
steps.description: Set AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT to your resource hostname, then call Analyze Invoice with a urlSource pointing at a sample invoice. The API replies 202 Accepted; copy the result ID (GUID) from the Operation-Location response header.

steps.title: Fetch the result
steps.description: Call Get Analyze Result with the same modelId (prebuilt-invoice) and the result ID. Poll until status is 'succeeded', then read the extracted fields from analyzeResult.documents.

notes: Analysis is asynchronous: analyze calls return 202 with no body; the result ID must be read from the Operation-Location response header
Analyze results are retained for 24 hours, after which the result ID expires
All tools pin api-version 2024-11-30 (GA v4.0); region availability and model versions are listed in the Azure docs
Either urlSource or base64Source must be set on analyze calls, never both
